issue_context.title: Long auto-analyze txn blocks GC
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

After #32726, the auto-analyze txns will not be interrupted by GC, instead, it blocks GC. The auto-analyzes will not repeatedly fail by blocking GC, but it brings some performance degradation when GC is blocked for a long time.

Either make auto-analyze fast enough or not execute auto-analyze it in a txn can improve this case.

review_comments:
we can get session id from tmp.sessionvars.id
the rest LGTM

I think it's safer to distinguish the `processid` and `sessionid`, comparing the `processid` explicitly avoids the implicit constraint that they must be the same as the `analyze` process injects the `processid` at the start. 
Anyway, this is a temporary solution and could be removed after the decoupling of analyze worker and garbage collection.
